# glad -- OpenGL 3.3 core loader (vendored, generated)

Generated by [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) 2.0.8. Not a submodule: the
generator's output is the dependency, and it is small and never edited by hand.

Only the extensions StarCanopy may use are included, which keeps the loader
readable. To add one, regenerate rather than edit:

```bash
python3 -m venv /tmp/glad-venv && /tmp/glad-venv/bin/pip install glad2==2.0.8
/tmp/glad-venv/bin/glad --api gl:core=3.3 \
  --extensions GL_KHR_debug,GL_ARB_texture_filter_anisotropic,GL_EXT_texture_filter_anisotropic \
  --out-path extern/glad c
```

Licences: the generated code is `(WTFPL OR CC0-1.0) AND Apache-2.0` (the latter
covers the Khronos XML it is generated from); `include/KHR/khrplatform.h` is
Khronos's MIT-style licence, in its header. See `THIRDPARTY.md`.
